headline: Wardens Sweep Godcrofts as Central Battlefields Suffer Heavy Casualties
war_summary: Warden forces have completed a sweeping consolidation of Godcrofts, bringing all nine strategic strongholds across the archipelago under their banner following intense island skirmishing. On the western seas, Fisherman's Row has cooled into complete Colonial possession after earlier contention. Major friction has now concentrated along the central and northern interior. Weathered Expanse endures the war's fiercest attrition, logging over eighteen hundred casualties in the last two hours alone while remaining split four bases to four with one site reduced to no-man's-land. In Linn of Mercy, Colonials maintain ten bases as fighting over Rotdust leaves a strategic position vacant. Mooring County sees renewed disruption as clashes over The Wind Hills leave that position neutral among an otherwise Warden-held province. Further east, Stlican Shelf remains divided six to three with fresh fighting reported near Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, while Stonecradle stays tightly contested in a five-to-four posture marked by heavy casualty exchanges.
